interface.label: Interface
interface.description: The tunnel's interface name. A link of this name existing is what the widget reads as connected.

config_file.label: Config file
config_file.description: The AmneziaWG configuration awg-quick is given. Naming the file rather than the interface is what lets the conf live outside /etc/amneziawg.

up_glyph.label: Connected glyph
up_glyph.description: Shown by the bar widget and the control-center tile while the tunnel is up.

down_glyph.label: Disconnected glyph
down_glyph.description: Shown by the bar widget and the control-center tile while the tunnel is down.

path.label: Command path
path.description: PATH handed to the elevated command. pkexec replaces the inherited one with the FHS bin directories, which hold nothing on NixOS, and awg-quick needs to find awg.

show_label.label: Show label
show_label.description: Print the interface name beside the glyph. Off leaves the glyph alone.
